── layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
· over the approval card · after the handover
keys · the approval card and the /run confirm                                                                         [?] back
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[y] allow
[n] deny
[e] edit the command before it runs
[a] allow without asking, or the queue
[t] dry run
[enter] open the full view
[g] go to the agent that asked
[shift+↑] scroll the card up
[shift+↓] scroll the card
[shift+←] pan a wide body back
[shift+→] pan a wide body

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
keys · [esc] back to the approval card and the /run confirm

keys · reading mode                                                                                                   [?] back

[↑↓/jk] move
[←] along the strip, back
[→] along the strip, on

[c] copy
[/] filter
[n/N] match
[ctrl+u/ctrl+d] half page
[pgup] page up
[pgdn] page down
[esc] back
▎[ctrl+space/ctrl+y] commit
